item.title: Preferences
item.description:
Settings on the rail, or the avatar, opens in the terminal column. The page says Saved on this machine.

Primary email link

An address stored on this machine loads that Gravatar in place of the initials. If the address is empty, or Gravatar has no photo, the initials stay. The shot above shows GK.

item.title: Free and Pro editions
item.description:
Termorq has Free and Pro builds. The edition appears beside the application version in the window header. The Free header includes created by Garrard Kitchen; Pro omits this credit. Open License from the left rail to compare plans; the current build is highlighted.

The root features.yml manifest is the source of this feature list and the app’s feature availability. Every new feature must have an explicit plan assignment there.
